'''Kumiko''' is a woman from the [[Kin]].

== Appearance ==
She is stout with graying hair.

Kumiko is very weak in the [[One Power]], she is not strong enough to become [[Accepted]].{{ref/book|11|13}} This means that she is below the level {{opsl|51}}.

== Activities ==
She [[Travel]]s with the rest of the Kin from [[Ebou Dar]] to [[Caemlyn]].

She helps [[Elayne Trakand]] in Caemlyn by linking with other Kinswoman and creating [[Gateway]]s for troops to Travel through, when the castle is being attacked by [[Arymilla Marne]]'s men.
